subjects.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/fog:HSD_FogSet
subjects.behavior: Null disables depth fog and returns without range-adjustment reset. Non-null requires current CObj, programs type/range/color with camera near/far, then enables range adjustment or explicitly disables it. Center formula is viewport_x + viewport_width*(center+320)/640, converted to s32 then clamped 0..640. Width zero reconstructs current projection; nonzero uses stored matrix.

evidence.why: Null disables depth fog and returns without range-adjustment reset. Non-null requires current CObj, programs type/range/color with camera near/far, then enables range adjustment or explicitly disables it. Center formula is viewport_x + viewport_width*(center+320)/640, converted to s32 then clamped 0..640. Width zero reconstructs current projection; nonzero uses stored matrix.
